Digipeater service and biological experiments.
Description
  • To provide a Ham Radio digipeater service.
  • To validate the feasibility of conducting biological experiments in space using a pico-satellite platform, incorporating a Lab-on-Chip design.
  • Help students set up their own ground stations to receive signals from said satellite and any other LORA based satellites.
